props.text:
$BTC Monday pattern deviation observed. Historical 10/10 occurrences show Monday highs followed by ~2% weekly drops; current week (Aug 18) is deviating from this pattern. Trader thesis: algo is shifting.

Charts show 11 consecutive Monday highs with consistent decline structure; current Monday at different formation phase. 64.5K range currently, pattern deviation suggests structural market shift.

Aligns with tactical scalping discipline but also validates broader consolidation thesis (62.8K-65.7K range establishing key technical levels).
